info.name: EventKu API - QA Test Suite
info.description:
# EventKu API - QA Test Suite (Alexa, QA & DevOps)

Koleksi pengujian API EventKu (Auth, Event, RSVP, Penyelenggara, Admin, Keamanan, Performa).

## Cara pakai
1. Import collection ini + file Environment, pilih Environment "EventKu Local".
2. Isi `adminEmail` dan `adminPassword` di Environment (sama dengan ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD di backend/.env).
3. Di backend/.env set `RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=false` lalu restart server (kalau tidak, Run utama kena 429).
4. Collection Runner -> pilih folder 0 s/d 8 (hapus centang folder 9 & 10) -> Run.
5. Folder 9 (Performa): jalankan sendiri, Iterations 50. Folder 10 (Rate limit): jalankan sendiri, Iterations 35, dengan rate limit aktif & server baru di-restart.

Setiap run membuat data baru berawalan "QA" dengan runId unik, jadi aman diulang. Sebaiknya jalankan di database/branch Neon khusus testing.

item.name: 9. Performa (NFR-PERF-01 & NFR-SCAL-02)
item.description: Jalankan folder ini sendiri di Collection Runner dengan 50 iterasi, lalu lihat request 9.04 untuk p95. Target: p95 < 500 ms (endpoint inti) dan < 300 ms (pencarian event).

exec: const t = pm.response.responseTime; const a = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("perfCatalog") || "[]"); a.push(t); pm.collectionVariables.set("perfCatalog", JSON.stringify(a));
pm.test("Waktu respons 500 ms (NFR-PERF-01): " + t + " ms", () => pm.expect(t).to.be.below(500));
const t = pm.response.responseTime; const a = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("perfSearch") || "[]"); a.push(t); pm.collectionVariables.set("perfSearch", JSON.stringify(a));
pm.test("Waktu respons 300 ms (NFR-SCAL-02): " + t + " ms", () => pm.expect(t).to.be.below(300));
const t = pm.response.responseTime; const a = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("perfAuth") || "[]"); a.push(t); pm.collectionVariables.set("perfAuth", JSON.stringify(a));
pm.test("Waktu respons 500 ms (NFR-PERF-01): " + t + " ms", () => pm.expect(t).to.be.below(500));

item.name: 9.04 Ringkasan p95 (lihat hasil di iterasi terakhir)

exec: const p95 = (a) => { const s = [...a].sort((x, y) => x - y); return s[Math.min(s.length - 1, Math.ceil(0.95 * s.length) - 1)]; };
const c = get("perfCatalog"), s = get("perfSearch"), a = get("perfAuth");
console.log("Sampel:", c.length, "| p95 katalog:", p95(c), "ms | p95 pencarian:", p95(s), "ms | p95 login:", p95(a), "ms");
